Text: For the past few weeks, I've been waking up every morning with the overwhelming feeling that today will be the best day ever.
I decided my favorite snack was fruit leather and ate only that for 5 days.
I got my shot to direct a film and chose to make an action movie.
I have been enrolled in primary school at Aaltonen Primary School.
I kicked my stepfather's face!
I pounded a glass of glitter that my classmate, Dragoljub Lazic, dared me to drink, then got sent to the nurse's office.
I was crowned ruler of the balance beam at recess.
I went to play bingo at the community center with my mother.
I went with some friends to Oak Tree Casino.
I've been wondering what it would be like to live in the wealthiest part of Helsinki when I'm grown up.
Krista Ahonen unfriended me.
Lately, I've been wondering whether "figuratively" will one day be said as much as "literally".
My half sister, Inka, has been promoted to Petty Officer Second Class.
My half sister, Inka, started primary school.
My half sister, Nea, started secondary school.
My half sister, Sanna, started secondary school.
My mother and my stepfather had a baby girl named Inka Tuominen, my new half sister. She was an accidental pregnancy.
My mother and my stepfather had a baby girl named Sanna Tuominen, my new half sister. She was a planned pregnancy.
My mother has been promoted to General Manager.
My mother has been promoted to Tour Operator.
My mother started a new position as Travel Associate for Helsinki Travel. She is no longer suffering from constipation.
My stepfather convinced me that I'm invisible. I told my mother about his behavior.
My stepfather pranked me by giving me nasty, salty cupcakes for my birthday.
My vizsla, Hazel, ate my fruit snacks. I rewarded her with a Porterhouse steak.
My vizsla, Hazel, perished after losing her last fight, against old age.
